messages:
sasha: Heads up — master CI is failing right after the latest toolchain image roll. CMake configure errors out: target 'redwood::runtime_x86_64' not found. Failing job: https://ci.redwood.ai/teams/infra/pipelines/12345/builds/67890 :frowning:
kevin: @sasha can you paste the configure log or the exact CMake error? is that a CMake target or something generated by our scripts?
sasha: It's CMake. Snippet:
```
CMake Error at cmake/RedwoodTargets.cmake:42 (add_library):
  Cannot find target "redwood::runtime_x86_64" referenced in INTERFACE_LINK_LIBRARIES
```
We didn't touch CMake in the last PRs; failure started immediately after infra/toolchains bumped the gcctoolchain image (infra#212).
maria: :eyes: Could be the image dropped some multilib headers or changed uname detection. The generator might skip creating the alias if detection fails.
jamie: I saw something similar last month — our multiarch target generator runs a tiny compile probe and bails silently if it can't compile with -m64 on the image. New slim image often misses libc6-dev:amd64-devel stuff.
kevin: Can we confirm by rerunning the job with the previous image? @devops-bot can you re-run build 67890 but override image=gcctoolchain:v12?
devops-bot: Requested rerun of build 67890 with override image=gcctoolchain:v12. New job queued: https://ci.redwood.ai/teams/infra/pipelines/12345/builds/67891
sasha: Thanks — I'm also going to add a small guard in the generator so it doesn't emit arch-specific aliases if probe fails, plus a VERBOSE_DETECT env var. Quick hotfix while infra sorts the image. OK?
maria: Sounds good. Please add diagnostic output so we can see the probe compile output in CI logs.
jamie: If rerun with v12 succeeds then we can blame the image change and file an infra ticket to pin missing packages. If it still fails we'll bisect commits between the toolchain bump and last green.
devops-bot: Rerun completed: build 67891 — SUCCESS :tada:
kevin: OK that isolates it to the new image. Sasha, go ahead with the guard + diagnostic. Also open an infra issue to add multilib headers into the new image or document the change.
sasha: Opening PR now with the guard + debug flag. Will link here once CI on PR runs. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/compare/fix/toolchain-detect
jamie: :shipit: after the PR passes CI. And add a blurb in release notes about the image/toolchain change so other teams are aware.
sasha: PR linked and CI queued. Thanks all for the quick triage.
